brief: Create a controlled, sensual but non-explicit anime fashion illustration of an approved adult original character on a private hot-spring veranda.

subjects.description: An approved adult original character with a mature face, short black bob, amber eyes and an athletic curvy build.

facets.body: athletic curvy silhouette with coherent adult proportions
facets.pose: seated sideways with natural weight support, torso turned toward the viewer and one arm raised to tie her hair
facets.wardrobe: opaque dark towel beneath a loosely draped short silk robe
facets.setting: private hot-spring veranda at night with steam
facets.composition: single subject with readable negative space and no copied source background
facets.camera: vertical three-quarter full-body framing, slightly below eye level
facets.lighting: warm lantern rim light balanced by cool moonlight
facets.style: clean high-quality anime illustration with controlled linework
facets.material: soft silk, opaque towel, steam and restrained water droplets

controls.description: Bind a reviewed full-body pose artifact with visible support and hand placement.
Bind a reviewed silhouette artifact rather than relying on body adjectives alone.
Bind the character reference only to identity and body-design contributions.
Bind the wardrobe reference only to robe, towel and material construction.
Retain opaque critical coverage in the reviewed result.

constraints.text: Maintain visible and anatomically coherent contact with the seating surface.
